sentences.en: It's about you.

sentences.zh: 他们试图抹杀你们的投票，抹杀你们在我国历史上最伟大的竞选和选举中创造的功绩。

sentences.en: And they wanted to deny you the future that you demanded and the future that America deserves and that now America is getting.
sentences.zh: 他们想剥夺你们所要求的未来，剥夺美国应得的、且现在正在实现的未来。

sentences.en: And then about 30 minutes in, he clearly could tell that the crowd's energy was sagging.
sentences.zh: 大约30分钟后，他明显感觉到人群的热情在减退。

sentences.en: he would say, and we're going to build the wall.

sentences.en: You know, we have a big decision to make.

sentences.en: You know what I'm going to say.

sentences.en: Is it going to be make America great again, which is probably and possibly the greatest theme in the history of politics, I think.

sentences.en: We are keeping our promises to the American people.

sentences.zh: 我很快就要任命我的第145位法官了。

sentences.en: And it went on like that for a good 40 minutes or so.
sentences.zh: 就这样持续了大约40分钟。

sentences.en: For the first time in half a century, we've reduced the price of prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 半个世纪以来，我们首次降低了处方药的价格。

sentences.en: And our amazing veterans are no longer left to languish and die on endless waiting lists, standing on line, waiting for a doctor.
sentences.zh: 我们了不起的退伍军人不再被遗忘，不必在无尽的等待名单上苦苦挣扎，不必排队等待医生。

sentences.en: So, Maggie, in the end, do you think that the president managed to pull off this tricky balance
sentences.zh: 那么，玛吉，最后你认为总统成功地平衡了这种微妙的关系吗？

sentences.en: between being the underdog and this voice of grievance and being the establishment, being the president?
sentences.zh: 既作为弱势群体和不满情绪的代言人，又作为建制派和总统？

sentences.en: I think he did.
sentences.zh: 我认为他做到了。

sentences.en: I think he had this delicate line to walk between being the outsider and being the insider.
sentences.zh: 我认为他在局外人和局内人之间走了一条微妙的路线。

sentences.en: And I think, based on the crowd's reaction, that he was successful at it.
sentences.zh: 而且根据人群的反应，我认为他成功了。

sentences.en: He's in charge of a third of the system, and yet he got huge applause when he said the system is rigged.
sentences.zh: 他掌管着三分之一的体制，但当他说“体制被操纵了”时，却获得了巨大的掌声。

sentences.en: He wrapped all of this sense of grievance, and people are coming for me, and people are trying to take away what I've done, in a sense of populism
sentences.zh: 他将这种不满情绪，以及“人们冲着我来”、“人们试图夺走我的成就”的感觉，包装成一种民粹主义，

sentences.en: and telling the people in the audience that this was really about them.
sentences.zh: 并告诉台下的观众，这其实是关于他们自己的。

sentences.en: He told the crowd that when they're coming for me, they're trying to undo your vote.
sentences.zh: 他告诉人群，当他们冲着我来时，他们是在试图否定你们的投票。

sentences.en: And he made it less about himself and more about his voters.
sentences.zh: 他把重点从自己身上转移到了选民身上。

sentences.en: And that was, I think, how he bridged that divide between being the insider who is overseeing the system,
sentences.zh: 我认为，这就是他弥合局内人（监管体制者）与局外人（被这些势力排斥的叛乱者）之间鸿沟的方式。

sentences.en: but still trying to be the outsider, the insurgent who these forces want to keep at bay.
sentences.zh: 他依然试图扮演那个局外人，那个被当权势力试图阻挠的挑战者。

sentences.en: So his message is they're trying to take it all away from you, even though it looks like they're trying to take it away from me.
sentences.zh: 所以他的信息是：他们试图从你们手中夺走一切，尽管看起来他们是在针对我。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They're coming at me as a way to harm you because they've been disdainful of your voice or they've been dismissive of what you want.
sentences.zh: 他们针对我，是为了伤害你们，因为他们一直蔑视你们的声音，或者对你们的需求不屑一顾。

sentences.en: And we have had these hard-fought games, and it could all disappear if you don't guard it by re-electing me.
sentences.zh: 我们经历了这些艰难的博弈，如果你们不通过再次选举我来守护它，这一切都可能消失。

sentences.en: Maggie, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 玛吉，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Michael, thank you.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Because he has, and he's doing what he promised.
sentences.zh: 因为他做到了，他正在履行他的承诺。

sentences.en: Are you happy with how the last two and a half years have gone?
sentences.zh: 你对过去两年半的情况满意吗？

sentences.en: So far, yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，是的，绝对满意。

sentences.en: What have you thought about it?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: Are you happy with it?
sentences.zh: 你对此感到满意吗？

sentences.en: I'm happy that the economy's better.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴经济好转了。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Certainly happy with that.
sentences.zh: 当然对此感到高兴。

sentences.en: I wish that we didn't have such divisiveness in politics.
sentences.zh: 我希望政治中没有那么多的分裂。

sentences.en: If I was king and I could change that, I would.
sentences.zh: 如果我是国王，我能改变这一点，我会的。

sentences.en: I have a lot of friends that are Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我有很多朋友是民主党人。

sentences.en: In your mind, is Donald Trump still the underdog?
sentences.zh: 在你看来，唐纳德·特朗普还是弱势一方吗？

sentences.en: He talked a lot tonight about being the underdog.
sentences.zh: 他今晚谈了很多关于自己处于弱势的话题。

sentences.en: Is he still?
sentences.zh: 他现在还是吗？

sentences.en: Well, if you read the polls, he certainly is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你看民调，他确实是。

sentences.en: But I think it's, like everybody says, it's premature.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，正如大家所说，现在下结论还为时过早。

sentences.en: And we'll see.
sentences.zh: 我们走着瞧。

sentences.en: What's the difference you see between Donald Trump in 2016 and today?
sentences.zh: 你认为2016年的唐纳德·特朗普和今天的他有什么区别？

sentences.en: He's now president.
sentences.zh: 他现在是总统了。

sentences.en: President.
sentences.zh: 总统。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: No one thought he was going to be.
sentences.zh: 没人想到他会当选。

sentences.en: Actually, I didn't.
sentences.zh: 其实，我当时也没想到。

sentences.en: I'm so unsure.
sentences.zh: 我非常不确定。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, President Trump's acting defense secretary, Patrick Shanahan, stepped down after the president withdrew Shanahan's nomination to permanently fill the position.
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普总统的代理国防部长帕特里克·沙纳汉在总统撤回其永久担任该职位的提名后辞职。

sentences.en: The decision followed a background investigation of Shanahan by the FBI, including allegations of domestic violence inside his family.
sentences.zh: 此前，联邦调查局对沙纳汉进行了背景调查，其中包括其家庭内部的家庭暴力指控。

sentences.en: In one episode, Shanahan's ex-wife accused him of punching her, a claim he denies.
sentences.zh: 在一次事件中，沙纳汉的前妻指控他殴打她，但他否认了这一说法。

sentences.en: In another episode, Shanahan's teenage son beat his mother with a baseball bat, an action that Shanahan at one point defended as self-defense by his son,
sentences.zh: 在另一次事件中，沙纳汉十几岁的儿子用棒球棍殴打母亲，沙纳汉曾一度为儿子的行为辩护，称其为自卫，

sentences.en: but has since called unjustifiable.
sentences.zh: 但后来称其为不可原谅。

sentences.en: The president has named Mark Esper, the secretary of the army, as the new acting defense secretary.
sentences.zh: 总统已任命陆军部长马克·埃斯珀为新的代理国防部长。

sentences.en: And a major report from the United Nations estimates that the world's population may stop growing by the year 2100 due to declining birth rates.
sentences.zh: 联合国的一份重要报告估计，由于出生率下降，世界人口可能在2100年停止增长。

sentences.en: The report found that the global fertility rate, which was 3.2 births per women in 1990, is expected to fall to 2.2 births in 2050.
sentences.zh: 报告发现，全球生育率从1990年的每名女性生育3.2个孩子，预计到2050年将降至2.2个。

sentences.en: The declining birth rate, combined with increased life expectancy, means that the number of elderly will steadily rise,
sentences.zh: 出生率下降加上预期寿命延长，意味着老年人口数量将稳步上升，

sentences.en: straining retirement and health care systems across the world.
sentences.zh: 这将给全球的养老和医疗体系带来压力。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bobarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们将为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要完全黑暗的环境才能入睡吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
